jellyfish_bloom.title: The Great Jellyfish Bloom
jellyfish_bloom.story: Moon jellies drifted into the kelp beds overnight, stinging every farmer who tries to harvest.

beached_whale.title: A Whale Comes to Rest
beached_whale.story: An old whale settled on the outer reef, and the whole city is feasting on the fish that followed.
beached_whale.means: Kelp is 40% cheaper this season. Fill your cellar.

crab_raid.title: The Crab Raid
crab_raid.story: Giant spider crabs marched through the granaries and snipped every kelp bundle in reach.

glowing_tide.title: The Glowing Tide
glowing_tide.story: Glowing plankton lit the canals, and the kelp beds grew twice as fast.

pearl_strike.title: The Pearl Divers Strike
pearl_strike.story: The pearl divers won't dive until the Council mends their cracked air-bells.

counterfeit_pearls.title: Counterfeit Pearls
counterfeit_pearls.story: Painted fish-eyes are being sold as pearls, and now every buyer haggles.
counterfeit_pearls.means: Pearls sell for 20% less this season.

diving_bell_tourists.title: Tourists in Diving Bells
diving_bell_tourists.story: Surface nobles came down in brass diving bells and bought pearls by the fistful.
diving_bell_tourists.means: Pearls cost 20% more, kelp 10% more, this season.

kraken_sighting.title: A Kraken in the Shipping Lanes
kraken_sighting.story: A tentacle thick as a temple column rose beside a Leviathan Line ship.
kraken_sighting.means: Leviathan Line fell 15%, and storms are likelier this season.

royal_contract.title: A Royal Contract
royal_contract.story: The Queen of the Coral Isles chartered the Leviathan Line for a year.

new_trade_route.title: Oro's Daughter Finds a New Route
new_trade_route.story: Captain Oro's youngest found a safer current around the Shark Teeth.

deepcoral_map.title: A Treasure Map Turns Up
deepcoral_map.story: Deepcoral bought a "genuine" treasure map from a stranger in a tavern.
deepcoral_map.means: Deepcoral shares jumped 50%. The map may be fake.

current_reversal.title: The Current Runs Backwards
current_reversal.story: For one day the great current ran backwards, and every ship turned home.
current_reversal.means: Every house fell 10%. Panics can be a chance to buy.

seahorse_derby.title: The Seahorse Derby
seahorse_derby.story: Derby winners showered pearls on their jockeys. Oro's crew bet on the slowest seahorse.
seahorse_derby.means: Pearls cost 15% more; Oro & Daughters slipped 5%.

eel_blackout.title: The Eel Blackout
eel_blackout.story: The eels that light the Grand Market went on strike. Stalls trade by lantern.
eel_blackout.means: Kelp costs 20% more; pearls sell for 10% less.

kelp_blight_scare.title: Blight in the Kelp Beds
kelp_blight_scare.means: Kelp costs more this season. A full cellar doesn't care.

storm_warning.title: Storm Warning
storm_warning.means: Voyages are likelier to fail this season.

fraud_charge.title: A Charge You Don't Recognize
fraud_charge.means: Dispute it this season for free, or it's gone.

pickpocket.title: Pickpocketed
pickpocket.means: Thieves take Purse coin. The Vault is safe.

roof_leak.title: The Roof Leaks
roof_leak.means: Paid from your Purse, then Vault, then card. Savings soften it.

surface_boom.title: Boom on the Surface
surface_boom.means: Silk and Silkwind are riding high this season.

tavern_rumor.title: Tavern Talk
tavern_rumor.means: Rumors are usually right. Only the Herald is always right.

lucky_salvage.title: Lucky Salvage
lucky_salvage.means: Found coin, straight into your Purse.

pearl_exchange.title: The Pearl Exchange
pearl_exchange.means: "Guaranteed" 40% a season. Who could pay that?

council_rate_change.title: The Council Moves the Vault Rate
council_rate_change.means: Your Vault earns a different rate now.
